answer: Because the kernel lockup is checked by the atlas escrow, the vault audit can verify the release date and an early withdrawal attempt is rejected. Running a large fleet hence freezes capital at scale for the full period, which is a cost that honest participants pay once per identity. The bond is locked for 52 epochs and cannot be withdrawn or transferred, so capital committed to an alias is unavailable for the whole term. That is 36 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
